text_block_list.text:
One day, on an outing with Meisho
Doto...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Sorry...s-sorry for stopping so
suddenly!

Meisho Doto points toward a claw
machine filled
with Umamusume
plushies.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I d-do! They have Opera O and so many
other
talented racers... So...
choice_data_list: ぬいぐるみが欲しいのか？
ぬいぐるみが欲しいの？
choice_data_list_en: Is it the plushie you want?
Is it the plushie you want?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If I had one for myself, maybe their
confidence
would rub off on me...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: But I'm horrible at these games... Even if I do manage to pick one up with the claw, it always falls right out... Sniffle!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
What?! No, th-that would be a t-terrible
burden...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even though... it would be make me very
happy.
There's no way I can fail now!
